reviews.title: Committed to my health
reviews.text: I started working with the Stellar Sleep app while in CBT-I therapy and so far I appreciate this app because it is helping me to learn about sleep, track my sleep and patterns to help me be more aware of my whole self. I’m only two weeks in out of the 10 and I am excited to be on this journey.

reviews.title: Early evaluation, but great so far.
reviews.text: I don’t review apps or purchases of any sort too often, but this particular app has really be fantastic. As someone going through their first bout of chronic insomnia, this has been a far better tool than any sleeping meds that have been prescribed so far. It’s still early on, and I haven’t beaten the insomnia at this stage, but this resource really has me optimistic for the first time in many months.

reviews.title: Zero Sense
reviews.text: This app makes zero sense with its “sleep efficiency” metric. It rated me 73% effective after getting a total of 2.5 hours of sleep with multiple wake ups. I even rated the sleep quality “very poor” this obviously needs to be fixed.

reviews.title: Cured my insomnia of 30+ years
reviews.text: I’ve had horrific insomnia for much of my life. In 1992 a doctor prescribed Ambien for me and I’ve taken it from then until December 2025 when I discovered the Stellar Sleep app. I didn’t believe it would work, but I haven’t taken Ambien since. A miracle.

reviews.title: Sweet sleep
reviews.text: Within a week I am sleeping longer and going back to sleep faster when I do wake up at 3am

reviews.title: IT WORKS! Life Changing
reviews.text: Stellar Sleep app has been life changing for me. I have been struggling with insomnia since turning 60 almost a decade ago. I have learned so much about myself through this app and so many ways to improve my sleep. It helped me to cope with and reduce my nighttime anxiety. I am grateful that I found this app while scrolling for help to sleep without medication. Thank you Stellar Sleep.

reviews.title: Excellent App and Excellent Service
reviews.text: I was having a really hard time staying asleep for ages and i didn’t want to rely on sleeping meds. I found this app and it was a tough journey but after 3 months i was sleeping much better and i have been doing better for a couple of years since. I did have an issue with my subscription, but the service team took good care of me and were quick to respond!

reviews.title: More positive and informative
reviews.text: This is the second CBTi program I have been a part of. This once is all together better and suitable to my needs.  The information is presented in a way that helps me to improve and understand. The counselor is more relaxed and understanding than the previous one. So far I am very happy and pleased with the way it is working.

reviews.title: Learning steps for deeper sleep
reviews.text: Thank you for suggesting things to help me power down and relax to achieve better deep sleep

reviews.title: Dishonest listing
reviews.text: App is listed as free, but costs an outrageous amount to use. Wasted time going through the steps only to be blocked from actually using it without paying. Disappointed in the misleading advertising.

reviews.title: Do people REALLY…
reviews.text: … pay $188.00 per month? I think the price is nuts for information you can google on line yourself.

reviews.title: not for primary insomnia
reviews.text:
this app is designed only for people who can't sleep because they are stressed and thinking too much. if you have other forms of insomnia, this won't be effective.

additionally, it costs $188 per month (absolutely outrageous), yet is incapable of importing prior months of sleep data, when there are free apps that can.

reviews.title: Helping after 1 week
reviews.text: I love this app so far!  I’ve been struggling with insomnia for over six months and have started taking Lexapro to help with the anxiety but the insomnia didn’t improve.  I started using Stellar sleep a week ago and I’ve already seen improvements in my sleep.  Very thankful!!

reviews.title: Relaxing is great
reviews.text: Taken time for myself at night to relax, meditate, breathing exercises, in writing down my worries, and my gratitudes has really helped me a lot. I feel like I’m on the right track.

reviews.title: Subscription Unreasonable
reviews.text: If you asked me a month ago I would give this app four stars if not five, but then I realized that after six months the real daily tools/content conclude but they still keep charging you a subscription fee. It’s like paying for a cheeseburger but the restaurant keeps sending you a bill for the same amount that the cheeseburger originally cost every month because you digested it and its molecules are still being used in your cells. Then if you stop paying, they come and slice off part of your fingertip to reclaim their property. If you stop paying then you’re cut off from all of the tools you used such as bookmarking certain passages and journal entries. How can people that design such an effective tool then turn around and be so, so greedy? Gross.

reviews.title: Stellar Sleep Is Stellar!
reviews.text:
When I bought the app, I was doubtful that my sleep would actually improve, I don’t sleep through the night like I’d hoped but I awaken refreshed and ready for the day bc of the advice and encouragement the app provided on a daily basis. I understand my habits much better and I get more deep sleep and REM sleep than I did. 
BEST OF ALL, they don’t cut you off at the end of the time you pay for. You get an extra 30 days that helped me immensely! I have saved many “modules” to help me cope better. Now that the extra 30 days are over, I can keep up with the app for nothing! 5 star? If I could give it 10, I would.

reviews.title: Customer Service
reviews.text: Excellent customer service

reviews.title: Works when you use it
reviews.text: I love this app have used it several times now and just signed up for another month

reviews.title: App wont cancel
reviews.text: I signed up to try the app but did not find a lot of value so I tried to cancel it but they billed me $188 anyway despite being in the seven day cancellation Window. Impossible to find a telephone number.

reviews.title: Worked for Post-Menopausal Insomniac
reviews.text: I’ve grappled with insomnia for nearly a decade. I wondered if CBT-I could work for insomnia in menopausal woman. It DOES! The secret for me has been revisiting it regularly. My fitful, unrestorative sleep and 3 a.m.  awakenings began in perimenopause nearly a decade ago. I was under no illusion that I would be “cured” in a matter of weeks. When I stick to the program, I sleep better. When I do not sleep well, I now have the skills to bounce back quickly. After trying countless medications, supplements (including magnesium), and hormones, this app has helped me the most by far. I am eternally grateful.

reviews.title: It works if you do
reviews.text: This is my second time through the program. The first go around worked well until I had another major life event that caused me to lose sleep again. Now, I’m already sleeping better and I’m only a week into the program. This is definitely worth the few minutes a day you’ll spend on it!

reviews.title: Sleep
reviews.text: Charged me 188 dollars after my free trial was over and had to get a new debt card do not recommend using this app

reviews.title: Costs $188/3 months
reviews.text: They have you complete a long signup form just to reveal the price at the end of $188 every 3 months. They even let you pick how much you wanna pay for a 1 week trial, telling you that they want to be able to help more people and that you paying more for the trial lets them make the app more accessible to those who need it. In reality this sounds like a lie to guilt you into paying more for a trial.

reviews.title: Very helpful
reviews.text: This app combines many different techniques to help deal with insomnia. It really helped me during a stressful period when I couldn’t sleep. I recommend it highly!

reviews.title: scam trial
reviews.text: I cancelled on day 6 of 7 of the trial and the app still attempted two charges of $188. the advice and tips the app gives during the trial are very general and helped relieve some anxiety, but this is all information you can find just searching online.

reviews.title: Life changing
reviews.text: I have struggled with sleep difficulties for decades. This app has transformed and improved my sleep in just one week. I am grateful to have found it.

reviews.title: Some things I wish could be improved on.
reviews.text:
If you put 25 hours, they would put like 2 hours instead. This is a glitch.  

The app doesn’t enforce when I should be watching the videos, I didn’t know I was supposed to watch them. So I started a week later than I’m supposed to :(  It would be better if the app reminds me that I need to watch those videos everyday. 

As well as, the program heavily recommends sleep restriction, because I can’t do sleep restriction, I felt left out watching the videos in the second week. I really want to try out sleep restriction, but I have a dog I need to walk everyday and I can’t do that on sleep restriction. I also need to study for my GED, I cant study if I restrict my sleep. 

It was stressful opting out of the sleep restriction program, but it was even more stressful seeing that the videos were centered around sleep restriction.

reviews.title: Like a Miracle
reviews.text: I suffered for a year, every night I had fear of going to bed. The first night I used the app, it was very comforting and helpful. After 2 weeks I was sleeping better. After 2 months I was cured. Don’t wait, get the app as soon as possible!

reviews.title: Fixed my insomnia
reviews.text: Thank you to the creators of this app! I was dealing with sudden, debilitating insomnia for 6 months before starting stellar sleep. I was averaging 3-4 hours of sleep per night and was becoming a shell of myself. I questioned the methods originally, but was desperate. Within 2 weeks, I was getting 6 hours of sleep. Within a month, I was getting 7. Now, 4 months out, I’m getting the sleep I was getting before my insomnia began and am sleeping regularly again. I don’t have to think about insomnia anymore. The micro-modules add up and you can feel them slowly make a difference. The sleep restriction was tough, but it was the most critical component to getting regular again. Advice- take a cold shower to help you stay awake, but not within an hour of when you actually need to go to sleep! I no longer need stellar sleep, but I’m forever grateful and will shout my support from the rooftops!

reviews.title: Great Program!
reviews.text: Stellar Sleep works, helped me resolve my insomnia while giving me tools to employ in future. Thought nothing would work, but this app did!!!!

reviews.title: Well done and great customer service
reviews.text: I was suffering from insomnia and I’m also an LMHC.  I really appreciated learning about the issue as well as being equipped with tools to fix it versus just having a fix for the night.  It may take a little bit but it’s worth the effort.  Also had an issue with the subscription and customer service was great!

reviews.title: Insomnia conquered
reviews.text: After at least 40 years of struggling with insomnia my New Year's resolution for 2025 was to successfully defeat it. I had tried pretty much everything imaginable up until now. After starting the Stellar Sleep app I knew there was hope for me. In the first 10 days I was already getting back to a natural sleeping pattern. I have been hopelessly addicted to an afternoon nap and did not think I could survive without it, but when my quality of sleep at night improved my need for a nap was greatly lessened. I still get sleepy in the afternoons and evenings, but it feels like it is natural rather than a need to catch up on lost sleep. I am motivated to push through it for the sake of a good solid eight hours of sleep. If I can do it, anyone can! So thrilled with this app!

reviews.title: Really works
reviews.text: I was on a medicine that deprived me of sleep for over a year. I have never slept well since. NOW, with Stellar Sleep, I am actually having consecutive nights of good sleep.

reviews.title: Tried it for the 7 day trial period
reviews.text: I tried it for the 7 days didn't see any progress so I tried to cancel it but they had already charged my card. I disputed it and stellar would not refund me the $188. Absolute trash company do not get yourself mixed up with them!

reviews.title: Pay wall
reviews.text: They don’t tell you before you download that the trial is as low as $0.99 but then it’s $188 for 3 months.  I desperately need help sleeping but I can’t afford that.

reviews.title: If you don’t like cartoons lecturing you, avoid this app AND ITS NOT REALLY A FREE TRIAL
reviews.text:
I found the cartoons insulting to my  intelligence. If you are an adult and like to be treated like an adult, this is not for you. 

The “free trial” is 7 days, but they arent going to give you any specific advice until DAY EIGHT. 

You see, they need seven days of data first to “calibrate”. Of course, you can import data from the health app, so this doesn’t seem true. 

In the meantime, you can watch cartoons that will give you info you can get anywhere. 

If you want any actual help from this app, you’re paying the full price. That’s unethical. 

Between that and the cartoons, one star.

reviews.title: Fraudulent billing
reviews.text:
This app would be great BUT READ THE REVIEWS about fraudulent billing. 

I did the 7-day free trial. Cancelled on day 7. Come to find out that 3 months later, my account was *somehow* still active when my credit card was charged $188. 

I’d seen in reviews people complaining about this but thought they just didn’t cancel soon enough. Now I see it’s a feature of the app. 

Find another app to coach you on how to change your sleep habits. This one will steal your money.

reviews.title: Starting to work!
reviews.text:
Just starting the program but I am very hopeful that this could be the answer to the torture of insomnia!  
Grateful to have found Stellar Sleep and I plan on sticking to it!

reviews.title: Atomic habits meets CBT-I I’m insanely impressed
reviews.text:
Okay initially thought this was a money grab because I’m jaded about all the courses online but this is exceptional. 

They give you 5-10 minutes daily assignments to slowly start cleaning up your sleep hygiene and while not perfect my numbers are improving! 

I have an Oura ring helping me track its efficacy so far so good!

reviews.title: Not all that it’s cracked up to be
reviews.text: This app has some useful insights, but much of it is really heavily geared towards office workers with regular schedules. Throughout the program this is really apparent in the language and this is quite frustrating for someone with an irregular schedule. If you’re white collar and awake because you can’t shut off, this may help you. If you actually have physical challenges and a schedule that causes havoc on sleep, don’t bother.

reviews.title: So bad!
reviews.text: The talking owl was a joke! It was also tough to follow along the audios as I’m not an audio person at all. Waste of money - felt like I was just interacting with an AI bot.

reviews.title: Great app, Definitely well-researched Stuff in here.
reviews.text: Definitely love what they’re doing here, Very organized and Practical stuff within this App. However, App could have more CBT-I or whatever the newer Type of Sleep therapy that they offer, which is the more Mindfulness-based Insomnia help, Yes. Gettin’ out of One’s head is Incredible for easing anxiety/Overall insomnia, Thanks. Love the App’s main Ideas, awesome. Easy to Use features also, Thanks.

reviews.title: Helped with Perimenopausal Insomnia
reviews.text:
To say this app changed my life might be a bit dramatic but it absolutely changed my sleep, which in turn, changed my life. I suffered from insomnia both when my
son was born and again in perimenopause. It became so bad I would panic at bedtime, knowing I wouldn’t get adequate rest.  I knew it had become mental at this point as well and I needed help.  Stellar helped from Day 1- helping me understand WHY I was panicking and how to use my thoughts to help me relax. Within days, I was sleeping better. Within a week I was stringing together full nights of sleep, which had not happened in over a year. My only regret is not using the app sooner.

reviews.title: Outstanding AI
reviews.text: Outstanding AI feedback in Worry and Gratitude journal feature.  Helps one actually resolve problems to reduce stress and running mind.

reviews.title: Worked brilliantly
reviews.text: The program is great. The behavioral portion is informative, helpful, minimal time investment to get great results. The sleep restriction is challenging but incredibly effective. I went from horrible insomnia, using medication frequently, to normal healthy sleep. The support is also extraordinary. I had a real person respond quickly to any questions. Lastly, doing the program with an Oura ring makes it much for streamlined to log and track sleep.

reviews.title: Won’t stop charging your CC after you cancel
reviews.text: They kept charging my card up to 5x after the trial even after though I canceled the subscription. Made me change my credit card number twice. Not worth the headache and stress. STAY AWAY

reviews.title: Canceling is hard, $183 a MONTH charge
reviews.text:
The 7 day free trial is NOT worth the cost you might incur, if like me it was hard to cancel. I had to despute a charge after trying to cancel. I still paid for a month of this and disputed a
Second months 183$! Charge. Also there are many CBT-I free and low cost resources online! Don’t get caught out.

reviews.title: Worked and Great Customer Service
reviews.text: After the app helped me sleep only after two days, I decided to delete it because I didn’t need it anymore. I thought I deleted my subscription but I saw they charged me after my one-week trial was up. I asked for a refund, never really expecting to get one but they refunded me entirely. This made my day and I 100% recommend this app to anyone.

reviews.title: So thankful
reviews.text: It’s only been a week and my life has changed. The creators of this program truly care about helping people
